note: Each entry is a pinned git submodule under providers/. This project does NOT vendor or re-license their code; run scripts/providers.sh init to fetch them. Licences remain those of the upstream projects — see each `license` field before any redistribution or commercial use.

providers.purpose: One sentence -> team of AI expert agents -> verified deliverable. Zero-code YAML workflows, DAG multi-agent collaboration, 15 LLM providers (11 key-free), Web Studio / Desktop / Docker.
providers.integration: Primary automation engine. Run upstream Docker/Web Studio; call from this app via AUTOMATION_ORCHESTRATOR_URL.

providers.purpose: Complete AI agency agent library (frontend, marketing, community, QA personas with processes and deliverables). Feeds agent definitions into the orchestrator.
providers.runtime: Markdown/Shell agent definitions (Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot compatible)
providers.integration: Agent persona source for agency-orchestrator. No server process.

providers.purpose: 277 plug-and-play AI expert roles (Chinese market: Xiaohongshu/Douyin/WeChat/Feishu/DingTalk) for 20 tools. Companion agent library for agency-orchestrator.
providers.integration: Agent persona source for agency-orchestrator. No server process.

providers.purpose: Open-source AI workforce: specialized agents for development, growth, research, strategy and creativity with structured workflows.
providers.integration: Additional agent persona source for agency-orchestrator. No server process.

providers.purpose: Compact 135M-parameter local AI assistant with chat UI (ybt_app.py). Cheap/free on-device inference for drafts, classification and triage before escalating to larger models.
providers.licenseWarning: No clear open-source licence detected upstream. Treat as research/evaluation only — do NOT redistribute or build a commercial offering on it until the owner grants a licence.
providers.integration: Optional local model sidecar; call via YBT_ARMY_URL when running.

providers.purpose: Live streaming and screen recording: automated video/lesson/webinar capture, scene automation (obs-websocket) for content production pipelines.
providers.runtime: C/C++ desktop application (has 3 nested submodules of its own — fetch with --recursive)
providers.licenseWarning: GPL-2.0 copyleft. Run as a separate process/service; do not link its code into this proprietary app.
providers.integration: Separate media service. Control via OBS websocket (OBS_WEBSOCKET_URL / OBS_WEBSOCKET_PASSWORD).

providers.purpose: HTTP server / reverse proxy / load balancer: the public edge in front of this Next.js app, the orchestrator and media services (TLS termination, rate limiting, caching).
providers.runtime: C server (build from source, or use the official nginx Docker image / OS package using this tree as reference config source)
providers.integration: Deployment-time edge proxy. Reference config: providers/nginx.conf.example. The repo already ships a Caddyfile as a simpler alternative — use ONE edge proxy, not both.
